selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: For Charge pricing, resolve an applicable approved agreement first and use tariff fallback only when no agreement applies; a demo centered on agreement pricing does not remove the required tariff fallback behavior.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Preserve provider failure meaning: no authoritative rate is HTTP 404 NO_RATE, residual ambiguity is HTTP 422 PRICING_VALIDATION, and outage, denied, and idempotency failures remain distinct even when Booking safely projects MANUAL_PRICING_REQUIRED.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: W2-03 manual-pricing scope is persisted OPEN evidence plus Booking visibility; assignment, manual quoting, approval, resolution, and closure are separate workflow scope and must not be imported implicitly.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Treat pricing p99 at or below 800 ms as a provisional warm local acceptance target with host, concurrency, and sample size recorded; do not represent it as an approved production SLO without production-environment evidence.
